items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I'd say, Buddy was one of the best trombone jails in New Orleans ever for.

ctx.x: I used to have some better. I was going to ask some more about the trombone, the two brothers, Yank and Buddy. Which was the better trombone, do you think, Mooney? Which would you rather hear? If you had your choice to hear, was one of them better than the other? I was about to say.
I'd say, Buddy was one of the best trombone jails in New Orleans ever for. Buddy. Used to call him the Papa Trombone. Really, really?
Yeah. One of the very best.
